senses.gloss:
छ The aspirated letter corresponding to the preceding, and expressed
by Ch.

छ mfn. (छः-छा-छं)
 1. Pure, clean.
 2. Trembling, tremulous, unsteady.
m. (छः) Cutting, dividing.
 2. A part, a fragment.
 f. (छा)
 1.
Covering, concealing.
 2. An infant, a child, any young animal.
E. छो to cut, or छद् to cover, &c. affix ड.

छा f. (छा) A young animal.
 E. छो to cut, डा aff.
